as_told.title: Lone gray craft in trouble over the Plains of San Agustin
as_told.place_text: Plains of San Agustin, New Mexico

plain: In early July 1947 a flying saucer is said to have crashed on the Plains of San Agustin in New Mexico, with dead aliens aboard and one alive. A scientist named John Brandenburg tells it from what he has heard. He says that "roughly the morning of 4th of July an object crashed on the plains of San Augustine", about 100 miles from Roswell, the New Mexico town tied to a famous crash story of that summer. A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force site in Nevada, also brings it up. He speaks only of a lone craft that was "in deep trouble" over the plains in 1947 and says nothing of alien bodies. If true, it would mean more than one craft came down in New Mexico that summer.
